title: 화재 대피 안내도 읽기: 지금 어디, 어느 쪽으로?
objective: Read a 화재 대피 안내도 to find where you are, the closest exit, and the safety equipment, and follow the basic steps to get out safely.
summary: Read a Korean fire evacuation map to find your location, the way out, and the safety equipment.
note: The map is a sample from a made-up building. Real maps are posted near elevators, stairs and room doors.

task.title: Read and find information
task.line: Use the map and the word list on page 1 to answer each question.

sections.heading: Read the map: 새봄빌딩 5층
paragraphs: → 피난 방향: 왼쪽 비상계단 (약 15m) / 오른쪽 비상계단 (약 30m)
소화기: 엘리베이터 옆, 화장실 앞 | 옥내소화전: 비상계단 옆 | 비상벨: 복도 가운데 | 완강기: 505호 창문 옆
※ 화재 시 엘리베이터를 이용하지 마십시오. (Do not use the elevator in a fire.)

items.text: This map shows where you are and how to get out when there is a fire.
items.example: 화재 대피 안내도를 보면 비상계단이 어디에 있는지 알 수 있어요.

items.text: The dot (●) shows where you are standing now.
The arrows show which way to go out.
This is the door you use to get out in an emergency.
items.example: 가장 가까운 비상구는 왼쪽 비상계단 입구예요.

items.text: Use these stairs to go down when there is a fire.
You use it to put out a small fire.

items.gloss: indoor fire hydrant (a hose cabinet on the wall)
items.text: It is a box with a water hose for fighting a fire inside the building.
Press it to warn everyone in the building.
items.example: 비상벨을 누르면 건물 전체에 소리가 울려요.

items.text: It lets you go down slowly from a window when you cannot use the stairs.
This is the safe place outside where everyone meets.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: With smoke, 몸을 낮추고 (stay low) and cover your nose and mouth with a wet towel (젖은 수건). If the 문손잡이 (door handle) is hot, do not open the door.

exercises: Look at the 새봄빌딩 map. You are at 502호. Which emergency stairs are closer, and how far away are they? Answer in Korean in this form: "○○ 비상계단, 약 ○○m".
Choose the right word: 완강기는 ( 502호 / 505호 ) 창문 옆에 있어요.
Fill in the blank: 소화기는 엘리베이터 옆과 ____ 앞에 있어요.
Write O if it is safe and X if it is not: ① 연기가 많아서 서서 빨리 걸어갔어요. ② 문손잡이가 뜨거워서 문을 열지 않았어요. ③ 엘리베이터를 타지 않고 비상계단으로 내려갔어요.
Put the sentences in the right order: (가) 비상벨을 눌렀어요. (나) 대피 장소에 모였어요. (다) "불이야!"라고 외쳤어요. (라) 계단으로 대피했어요. (마) 밖에서 119에 신고했어요.
answers: ① X ② O ③ O
